name: beatnest
description: BeatNest - a React + Express music player with Mini Loop

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run assets && npm run sitemap && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.check: npm run check:secrets && npm run check:contrast && npm run check:links && npm run check:perf
